name: Control Chart (Time-Weighted)
description: EWMA and CUSUM for small persistent shifts
whenToUse: Detect small, persistent shifts earlier than a Shewhart chart: EWMA weights recent values, CUSUM accumulates deviations from the target.
typeHint_ewma: Smooths the series and detects small persistent drifts.
typeHint_cusum: Accumulates deviations from target — very sensitive to 1σ shifts.
baselineHint: Number of points used to estimate target and σ (empty = all).
sigmaMethodHint: MR̄/d₂ is more robust against outliers in the baseline.
paramNote_ewma: Rule of thumb: λ = 0.10 with L = 2.7 for 1σ shifts; λ = 0.20 with L = 3 as a balanced default.
paramNote_cusum: Rule of thumb: to detect a Δ·σ shift, choose k = Δ/2; h = 4 or 5.

invariants.chartKeys: Settings exist only for the sub-charts EWMA, CUSUM C⁺ and CUSUM C⁻.
